description.p: brow is an ultra-lightweight, ultra-fast, privacy-first web browser built on the Servo rendering engine and written in Rust. It pairs the parallel Stylo CSS engine and WebRender compositor with a network-level privacy stack that never phones home.

ul.li: Network-level ad and tracker blocking (EasyList/ABP engine, ~55k rules, microsecond decisions)
CNAME cloaking detection uncloaks third-party trackers hiding behind first-party DNS aliases
Anti-fingerprinting: canvas/WebGL/AudioContext defense with per-origin seeds
CHIPS partitioned-cookie enforcement so embedded services cannot join your identity across sites
HTTP/3 + QUIC transport, DNS-over-HTTPS, and COOP/COEP/CORP policy enforcement
Tab hibernation and content-addressed dedup caching for a <100 MB per-tab memory budget

description.p: First packaged release: cross-platform distribution engineering — Windows MSI and portable zip, Linux AppImage, .deb and .rpm packages, SHA256SUMS verification for every artifact, and a tag-driven release pipeline.
